for rec in self:
  rec['x_studio_employee_rate'] = rec.contract_id.wage/240

fields.name: x_studio_ot_hours
fields.compute:
for rec in self:
  ot_hours = 0
  currentdate = datetime.date.today()
  
  firstdayOfmonth = datetime.date(currentdate.year, currentdate.month, 1)
  next_month = currentdate.replace(day=28) + datetime.timedelta(days=4)
  lastdayOfmonth = next_month - datetime.timedelta(days=next_month.day)
  
  employee_ot = self.env['hr.attendance.overtime'].search([('employee_id', '=', rec.id),('date', '>=', firstdayOfmonth),('date', '<=', lastdayOfmonth),('duration_real', '>=', 1.00)])
  if employee_ot:
    for ot in employee_ot:
      ot_hours += round(ot.duration_real,2)
  rec['x_studio_ot_hours'] = ot_hours

views.name: hr_payroll_payslip_employees
views.arch:
This wizard will generate payslips for all selected employee(s) based on the dates and credit note specified on Payslips Run.

Set a specific structure if you wish to make an extra payslip (eg: End of the year bonus). If you leave this field empty, a regular payslip will be generated for all the selected employees, based on their contracts configuration.

Set a specific department if you wish to select all the employees from this department (and subdepartments) at once.

<tree string="Bank Data — Net Salaries" create="false" edit="false" multi_edit="0" sample="1">

                <header>
                    <button name="action_export_bank_data_csv" string="Export Paymaster XLSX" type="object" class="btn-primary"/>
                </header>

                <!-- Required by employee_id domain validation -->
                <field name="company_id" column_invisible="True"/>

                <!-- B  Destination Bank MICR (04) -->
                <field name="x_dest_bank_micr" string="Dest Bank (B)"/>
                <!-- C  Destination Branch (03) -->
                <field name="x_dest_branch" string="Dest Branch (C)"/>
                <!-- D  Destination Account (12) -->
                <field name="x_dest_account" string="Dest Account (D)"/>
                <!-- E  Destination Account Name (20) -->
                <field name="employee_id" string="Dest Name (E)"/>
                <!-- F  TRN Code (02) -->
                <field name="x_trn_code" string="TRN Code (F)"/>
                <!-- G  Return Code (02) -->
                <field name="x_return_code" string="Return Code (G)"/>
                <!-- H  Cr/Dr Code (01) -->
                <field name="x_cr_dr_code" string="Cr/Dr (H)"/>
                <!-- I  Return Date (06) -->
                <field name="x_return_date" string="Return Date (I)"/>
                <!-- J  Amount (12) — net salary -->
                <field name="net_wage" string="Amount (J)" sum="Total (LKR)"/>
                <!-- K  Currency Code (03) -->
                <field name="x_currency_code" string="Currency (K)"/>
                <!-- L  Originating Bank MICR (04) -->
                <field name="x_orig_bank_micr" string="Orig Bank (L)"/>
                <!-- M  Originating Branch (03) -->
                <field name="x_orig_branch" string="Orig Branch (M)"/>
                <!-- N  Originating Account (12) -->
                <field name="x_orig_account" string="Orig Account (N)"/>
                <!-- O  Originating Name (20) -->
                <field name="x_orig_name" string="Orig Name (O)"/>
                <!-- P  Particulars / Employee No (15) -->
                <field name="x_particulars" string="Particulars (P)"/>
                <!-- Q  Reference (15) -->
                <field name="x_cbc_reference" string="Reference (Q)"/>
                <!-- R  Value Date YYMMDD (06) -->
                <field name="x_value_date" string="Value Date (R)"/>
                <!-- S  Security Field (06) -->
                <field name="x_security_field" string="Security (S)"/>
                <!-- T  Filler (01) -->
                <field name="x_filler" string="Filler (T)"/>

            </tree>
